scope: Identify the exact strict DWG read-completeness failure for a local AC1024 civil sample and determine whether it is a reader defect or unresolved source membership.

source.provenance: Local untracked sample; not added to the repository

libdxfrw.strictOutcome: Refused before output preflight because LTYPE_CONTROL membership is incomplete

libredwg.minJsonRead: Succeeded and preserved the same null entry in the control list
libredwg.dxfWrite: Succeeded; this is tolerant-reader/exporter behavior, not strict graph-completeness proof

odaSpecification.statement: Numentries counts the soft-owner linetypes; BYBLOCK and BYLAYER are the two final hard-owner entries.
odaSpecification.boundary: The section does not establish whether a null reference inside the counted soft-owner slots is a valid tombstone or invalid membership.

conclusion: The local parser and LibreDWG agree on the physical null counted slot. No evidence shows a libdxfrw decode defect, and the current exact-membership gate correctly refuses to promote the graph while that slot has no target. Do not weaken the general strict gate based on tolerant peer output. A future bounded policy requires authoritative evidence that this null slot is a valid tombstone plus output/readback proof that preserves every live LTYPE and all references.
limitations: No native AutoCAD or ODA application qualification was performed for this source.
LibreDWG acceptance and DXF export demonstrate peer tolerance only.
The null slot's producer intent and tombstone semantics remain unresolved.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added to the repository.
